kjv: I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health
mine: I pray that all may go well with you and that you may be in good health
note: peri panton is "in all respects", not "above all things"; the KJV phrase has been used as a proof-text for a gospel of prosperity, which a conventional letter-greeting does not support.

mine: for the sake of the name
note: TR adds "autou" (his); absent from Sinaiticus, A, B, C.
